question: Within the specific Tiberian reading tradition and its cited witnesses, does the point in Alef mark consonantal realization alone or a distinct articulatory operation, and what can transfer to a symbol/sound model?
selection: Actual jev-1.14.0 selected tiberian_context 0.61 over recitation_duration 0.36 and latin_phonetic 0.03. Full v2 request, preview and receipt retained. Selection is an operational preference.

source.id: S02 extension, not a new whole-source census
source.title: Geoffrey Khan, The Tiberian Pronunciation Tradition of Biblical Hebrew, volume1 (2020), I.1.1, printed140–144
source.inspected: Selected source text and actual rendered printed142 and144; other cited pages140/143 extracted and available as rendered pages.

source_reports.report: Khan reports a competing interpretation, associated with Morag, that the point distinguishes consonantal Alef from non-consonantal Alef, analogous to mappiq, rather than marking gemination.
source_reports.status: Competing scholarly reading; retained without a source-weight vote.

source_reports.report: Khan identifies a Karaite Arabic-script transcription, BL Or2552 fol51r line1, corresponding to Job33:21. He dates the manuscript to the tenth or eleventh century and argues from its restricted use of shadda elsewhere that the Alef was read as geminate.
source_reports.status: Author's manuscript-based argument. The manuscript excerpt is visibly reproduced on printed142; this packet has not independently inspected the complete manuscript or dated it.

source_reports.report: Khan concludes that four canonical Standard Tiberian marked cases indicate gemination; he interprets the operation as additional articulatory effort and potentially longer laryngeal articulation, guarding against slurring.
source_reports.status: Source conclusion, not an original SUNNY proof or an Iron Age sound reconstruction.

host_inference: This inspected case supplies a source-qualified candidate operation on pronunciation, such as reinforced/extended glottal articulation, instead of requiring that a written symbol name a sustained musical frequency. It is a reusable component only when reading tradition, textual location and marking conditions match.
transfer_limits: A medieval Tiberian or Karaite witness does not automatically determine Paleo-Hebrew or Imperial Aramaic realization.
The source does not specify an absolute duration in seconds, a fixed two-to-one duration ratio, an F0, a musical interval, or an entire waveform.
Phonological gemination and visible doubled transcription are not by themselves an empirical timing measurement.
The four canonical loci are source-reported; raw codex token/mark verification remains a separate next check.
The competing mappiq-only interpretation is preserved, and Khan's argument from a witness's other shadda uses must be checked before broader transfer.
conditional_consequence: If a SUNNY mapping for this bounded reading tradition uses Alef, then textual location and mark/reading context must be available to distinguish consonantal, non-consonantal and reinforced/geminate candidates. A glyph-only lookup cannot encode this contrast without losing source information. That constraint leaves the adopted full musical/geometric premises available for testing.

discriminating_test.status: Proposed, not performed; no audio outcome or blind prediction claimed.
discriminating_test.contrast: Within one declared modern reading/reconstruction tradition, compare canonical marked cases with matched unmarked consonantal controls and separately with non-consonantal cases.
required_controls: Freeze source tokens and their manuscript/edition reading before audio inspection.
Use the same speaker and repeated readings with controlled speech rate, stress and melodic condition; words with different morphology/prosody are not interchangeable controls.
Annotate the presence and timing of glottal closure or glottalization. Keep duration, voicing, F0 and formants separate, and allow pitch to be undefined during closure.
Compare duration/articulatory contrasts under an explicit noise and annotation model; do not require an invented exact factor of2.
Treat modern reproduction as a performance/method control. It cannot alone establish the medieval or Iron Age realization.
discriminating_test.predictions: A gemination/strengthening interpretation predicts a systematic articulatory or timing distinction under an appropriate matched protocol. A consonantal-only marking interpretation does not by itself predict an additional duration category; stress and reading convention remain possible confounders.
discriminating_test.minimum_next_observation: A version-bound raw token pair and a recording or published acoustic analysis from a specified reading tradition, with enough context to distinguish closure from neighboring vowels.

exposure: Already exposed to the project, prior Alef census and Khan's chapter. This is source-led extension and reproduction planning, not independent rediscovery or a blind result.
unassessed_alternatives: The Berakhot13b recitation-duration lead and classical Latin phonetic comparison remain ready alternatives from the retained Jev distribution; no new power/M1–M12 census was silently substituted.
